The present Appeal has been filed on behalf of the Appellant under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 against the judgment dated 13.01.2025 [hereinafter referred to as "Impugned Award"] passed by the learned Presiding Officer, MACT, South East, Saket Courts, Delhi.

sentences.text: By the Impugned Award, compensation in the sum of Rs. 13,50,550/- has been awarded to the Respondent No 1./Claimant along with interest at the rate of 7.5% interest per annum.

2. At the outset, the learned Counsel appearing on behalf of the Appellant submits that the challenge in the present Appeal is not in the issue of quantum and that they will be complying with the award within a period of four weeks.
3. Learned Counsel appearing on behalf of the Appellant/Insurance Company submits that he has filed the judgments that he seeks to rely upon.
The same is, however, not on record.
